ABOUT.TITLE: I'm a fullstack engineer with 8+ years of experience.
ABOUT.SECTION_1: 🚀 As a dynamic software engineer, I've taken a global journey from my Lebanese roots to working for companies in Canada, KSA, USA and Lebanon.
ABOUT.SECTION_2: 💻 My passion for technology knows no bounds, and my journey is marked by creating physical security solutions, financial apps, compliance & AML integrations, intuitive POS systems, multitenant e-commerce platforms, and insurance sales portal while ensuring every project complies with the highest standards.
ABOUT.SECTION_3: 🌟 My mission is to turn complex challenges into elegant solutions that solve real-world scenarios. I'm dedicated to deliver excellence in every project, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in software engineering.
ABOUT.SECTION_4: 🌎 With a global perspective and a wealth of experience, I'm eager to embark on new opportunities to continue making a meaningful impact. Let's join forces and create something extraordinary! 🔥💼💡
